title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
US-Iran: US struck 3 Iranian oil tankers Sat; Iran launched missiles at US Navy warships. Fresh attacks Tue.
WTI $92.56 — 3rd consecutive daily gain heading toward $100. Goldman flags $120/bbl risk if Mideast attacks persist.
Goldman raised Dec-2026 WTI forecast +$5 to $80/bbl; Brent to $85 on prolonged Mideast shipping risk.
BTC $78,370 (-1.6% 24h); ETH $2,490 (-1%) — risk-off as geopolitical tensions + hike odds weigh.
FOMC Sep 16 hike odds: ~58–60% (CME FedWatch).
